notes: Manifest of SpriteCook-generated and SpriteCook-imported assets used by the GalaxyMonkey iOS target. Legacy normalized PNGs are not listed here; they live under sprite-pipeline/normalized/ and are imported into Assets.xcassets by import-to-xcassets.sh. Add a row here only when SpriteCook generates or imports something.

fields.sha12: Sha-256 prefix of the SpriteCook output (if downloaded).
fields.sha12_local: Sha-256 prefix of the source PNG used at import time, if this row was imported from a legacy file.
fields.label: Logical role, e.g. player_ship_canonical, gorilla_canonical.
fields.role: Game role: player | enemy | projectile | pickup | fx | ui | backdrop.
fields.asset_path: Ship path inside the iOS bundle, e.g. GalaxyMonkey/Assets.xcassets/Player.imageset/player.png.
fields.frames: For animations: number of frames in the spritesheet.
fields.loops: For animations: true if intended to loop.

assets.label: player_ship_canonical_v4
assets.prompt: Modernized realistic monkey-themed spaceship, top-down 3/4 view from above and slightly behind, fuselage pointing toward upper-right at standard cruise heading, perfectly level (0° bank), polished banana-yellow metallic hull with subtle panel lines and rivet detail, glass cockpit dome with stylized cartoon monkey face inside (chrome-rimmed visor, friendly grin visible through tinted glass), two swept-back wing fins with curved banana-peel silhouette in chrome, twin glowing cyan ion thrusters at the rear, soft directional rim-light from upper-left, subtle ambient occlusion under wings, no motion blur, no tilt, no banking, completely upright and symmetric, transparent background

assets.label: player_ship_canonical_v5
assets.prompt: Round flying saucer player spaceship, classic UFO disc shape, top-down 3/4 view from slightly above and behind, perfectly omnidirectional silhouette with no clear front or back, dark crimson-red polished metallic disc hull with concentric panel rings and rivet detail, raised glass dome cockpit on top with two or three cartoon monkey astronauts visible inside (helmets, friendly grins), warm cabin glow through the dome, subtle chrome trim around the disc rim, glowing cyan underglow ring beneath the disc suggesting anti-grav thrust, soft directional rim-light from upper-left, ambient shadow under the disc, level (no bank), centered in frame, transparent background, modernized realistic rendering of the original Galaxy Monkey saucer
assets.notes: Active player ship. Round saucer modeled on the legacy player.png (reference_asset_id=cb12d063, player_legacy_import). Omnidirectional silhouette — reads correctly regardless of slide direction. Banking handled in code: Player.swift lerps visual.zRotation toward -clamp(velocity.dx/maxSpeed,±1)*Tuning.Player.maxBankRadians (±30°) at Tuning.Player.bankApproachRate. Thruster repositioned beneath disc center (Player.swift init) pointing straight down so it vectors with the bank tilt.

assets.label: player_ship_v4_bank_attempts_failed
assets.notes: Six generate_game_art calls using f1e77256-af60-43d8-a3f9-2b4e2bf0a5c4 as reference_asset_id with explicit bank-angle prompts (-30, -20, -10, +10, +20, +30 deg) all returned visually-identical reproductions of the canonical pose. The model treats reference_asset_id as 'reproduce this asset' and ignores per-angle perspective directives. Same failure family as the prior animate_game_art 3D-rotation limit. Asset ids generated but unused: 7b154473-df54-4aa6-854f-1c2aa7f0142e, 13a7163f-cef7-4453-bbe9-e22603839b71, ed309331-25f2-44ce-acc6-e00bd2a21a77, eeb79d34-5882-4e33-b8a4-a13f9315b728, 2cb0f606-2b23-446f-8251-0a69ffd1260f, 6b22b5d9-06a4-4890-ac1f-50a0c148163b. Workaround shipped: code-driven zRotation in Player.swift.

assets.label: glow_halo_canonical
assets.prompt: A perfectly circular radial-gradient glow halo with a soft white-hot core that smoothly fades to fully transparent at the outer edge. Completely symmetrical, no rings, no streaks, no rays, no lens artifacts, no concentric bands. Designed as an additive-blend bloom layer to composite over explosions, muzzle flashes, and energy halos. Top-down view, centered on canvas, single soft falloff from white center to transparent edge. Transparent background.
assets.notes: Replaces the legacy 35×20 glow.png. Used by VFXPool for muzzleFlash, enemy-kill halo, and bomb halo at scales up to 2× Enemy.radius.

assets.label: app_icon_v1
assets.prompt: App icon for an iOS arcade space shooter called "Galaxy Monkey". Hero subject: the banana-yellow cartoon monkey-face spaceship from the reference, centered and slightly tilted toward the viewer at a heroic 3/4 angle, glowing twin blue ion thrusters firing downward, glass cockpit dome catching a starlight highlight, big friendly grinning monkey-face on the front of the hull, two banana-peel curved wing fins. Background: deep cosmic gradient from royal purple at the top to indigo and electric blue toward the bottom, soft pink/magenta nebula glow behind the ship forming a subtle halo, scattering of small white and pale-blue stars, one slightly brighter starburst flare near the ship's nose.
assets.notes: iOS app icon (1024x1024, PNG, no alpha). SpriteCook returned a JPEG-encoded 1024x1024 despite the 512x512 intent_size and .png extension; converted via sips. Style-locked to player_ship_canonical_v3 via reference_asset_id.

assets.label: player_spin_anim
assets.notes: DEPRECATED — no longer wired into Player.swift. AnimationSet.playerSpin enum case was removed; the .spriteatlas folder remains on disk for reference only. Replaced by static player_ship_canonical_v4 + code-driven bank tilt. History: was a continuous tumble loop. SpriteCook's animation engine produced 2D sprite rotation, not the requested 3D barrel-roll around the forward axis. Generated 8 frames at 5120×640; frame 1 dropped due to a consistent SpriteCook first-frame two-ship glitch, so the atlas uses 7 frames (sheet frames 2-8 renamed to atlas frames 01-07).
